prompt: Walk us through running a double materiality assessment under the revised ESRS.
assertions: Defines both lenses: impact materiality (inside-out) and financial materiality (outside-in), with a topic material if it meets either
Describes the process: context/stakeholder mapping, identification of impacts/risks/opportunities, scoring with defined thresholds, validation and documentation
Connects DMA output to disclosure scope: material topics drive which topical standards and datapoints apply (ESRS 2 general disclosures always apply)
Reflects the revised-ESRS simplification accurately (fewer mandatory datapoints; relief provisions) without claiming the DMA itself was abolished
Output is actionable: stepwise plan or table, with governance/audit-trail expectations for assurance readiness
